steps.note: Soured milk worked with Lactobacillus and yeast turns lactose into carbon dioxide and alcohol in about a day.

steps.name: distil
steps.note: Herders distil the fermented milk in a simple pot still and collect the spirit, which is up to about 10 % alcohol by volume.

sources.text: That arkhi is distilled from fermented milk, its strength, and how isgelen tarag is soured with bacteria and yeast; neither page gives the still or its temperatures.
